method: Manual comparison against independent facts fixed in corpus/manifest.json before any model call. Checks cover summary and key_points together; not a full precision metric or independent human rating.
engineering_rules: UI skills and three-layer tokens; skills outrank plans; configurable abilities; stable narrow interfaces; yt-dlp only through ytdlp_service.py and visuals read-only.

after.observation: One complete point preserves venue, Monday and maintenance; no padding or invented reopening details.

before.observation: All seven required facts retained with correct quantities, date replacement and conditional pause/manual action. Points 1 and 7 both explicitly repeat no expansion; point 3 also repeats deployment scope.

after.observation: All required facts retained: 2400 ceiling, 18 split 12/6, June 17 replacing June 10, four weeks, <22 percent manual action and three consecutive missing days. Explicit no wider deployment collected in final point; scope still appears contextually in points 1 and 2. Supplier/price/savings are not invented. Points remain long.

before.observation: All six facts retained through three section requests and merge. Old and final dates occupy separate points. Low-value rehearsal identifiers appear; approval scope is repeated.

after.observation: 48000 ceiling, 1200 records, six-week pilot, exactly 17 mismatches, rejected August 12 / conditional September 9 and Noor stop authority all retained. Superseded/final dates are combined in one point. No completion/downtime/reliability claim invented. Remaining issue: summary includes low-priority rehearsal counts; points 1 and 6 repeat pilot-only approval.

limits: Three self-authored artificial English sources, Chinese outputs, one before and one after output each; not a natural-video benchmark.
Short density fixture is 236 raw / 58 cleaned characters; medium 2411; long 40441. Long fixture stress-tests routing rather than realistic dialogue distribution.
No multi-run stability study, independent human evaluation, numerical precision/recall metric or latency improvement established.
The >60000-character regression uses deterministic local transport and proves content routing only; live long fixture is below 60000 but exceeds default chunk length.
Observed semantic repetition and verbose low-priority details remain. Prompt guidance does not guarantee factfulness or deduplication.
